main_text.head: LXXVI.
OSTFRISIÆ COMITIS EDSARDI Ad Legatum Responsio.
main_text.p: SAlutem & favorem nostram, Nobilis, dilecte, singularis. Hodie literas vestras accepimus & perlegimus, in quibus significatis nobis, quod Serenissimus & Potentissimus Princeps ac Dominus Dominus Henricus Rex Navarrenus &c. Dominus noster Clementissimus personam vestram ad se revocavit, deinde etiam postulatis à nobis, ut salvum

page.notes: The first letter S of the paragraph is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to "Alutem". Words in the first lines of the body are set in italic. The catchword "vum" and signature "S 2" are printed at the foot; the catchword is shown here as printed. Some letters in the scan are worn and uncertain, notably in the italic Latin names.
